verdict: A very close, well-structured rebuild whose most visible slips are a bold 'Featured article' heading (regular in the reference), body text set without Material's letter spacing, and a featured image cropped a few dp off; editable, with a templated bottom nav but hard-coded values everywhere.

top_defects.what: set in Roboto bold 24px; the reference uses regular weight (Material headlineSmall, 400), so the title reads much heavier
badge crop is shifted and scaled differently (crown top ~4-5 dp lower, edges offset): the heatmap's third row reaches meanDiff 24-39 across the image

top_defects.where: banner text, module description, card extract
top_defects.what: Roboto body text without the reference's ~0.25px tracking (lines ~5 dp narrower: 'about' ends at 817 vs 831 px); extract even uses -0.35px tracking, so its 4th line truncates at 'Cheltenham…' instead of 'Cheltenham Tr…'
'EN' letters 12px medium, visibly larger than the reference's ~10.5px; the box border is heavier/darker; Wi-Fi glyph slightly larger than the reference
136 arbitrary values with the same hex colors (#202122, #54595d, #3366cc) repeated inline instead of tokens; Save and Share buttons are copy-pasted rather than one repeated element

top_defects.where: featured article card and summary card
top_defects.what: card corner 18px and summary corner 10px vs 16 dp and 8 dp in the reference
'Community' and 'For you' labels sit ~1 dp higher than the reference, the indicator ~1 dp higher too
nav pinned with absolute top-[818px] instead of anchored to the bottom; card overlay positioned at top-[203px] by magic number

strengths: Every block and text of the reference is present with exact wording, colors from the Wikipedia palette (#3366cc tab, #eaecf0 banner, #e8f0ff Home pill, #b32424 dots)
Real assets for the wordmark, globe, badge and all nav/action icons, with the 39% black veil and translucent summary card reproduced
Bottom navigation built once as a data-driven template (5 items, pill and badge as fields), with clearly named groups throughout
